topic: Selling and buying at the same time
hook: Selling and buying at once. Which first?
hookSub: 3 ways to do it, and how to choose

slides.big: Sell first: you know your budget
slides.small: The money from your sale is in hand before you shop. You may need a short-term place to stay.

slides.big: Buy first: you move only once
slides.small: No rush to get out the door. Plan for paying for two homes for a while.
Put the sale and the purchase on one schedule, and ask for extra time to move out.
What your home will likely sell for and what the next one costs decide the order.

comment: Which would you pick: 1, 2 or 3? Tell us in the comments.
